scripts.text: - You still have unused skill points. Come back when you have used all of them. -
scripts.translation: - 你還有未使用的技能點。請在使用完所有技能點後再回來。-

scripts.text: Our Alchemist Union brings up many junior alchemists with various promotions and investigations.
scripts.translation: 我們鍊金術士工會通過各種晉升和研究培養了許多年輕鍊金術士。

scripts.text: They have spread to all corners of Midgard and were active in many fields like sciences or special item production methods.
scripts.translation: 他們遍佈米德加爾特，活躍於科學研究、特殊物品製作等各個領域。

scripts.text: We call the members of our new union ^3131FF'Geneticists'^000000.
scripts.translation: 我們將新公會的成員稱為^3131FF“基因學者”^000000。

scripts.text: Geneticists are the ones who have reached their peak potential in the world of Alchemy. They are the ones who currently spearhead alchemy throughout all of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 基因學者在鍊金術領域的造詣已臻巔峰，如今正引領整個米德加爾特的鍊金術發展。

scripts.text: It looks like you are an expert in this field, how about meeting other geneticists?
scripts.translation: 看來你是這方面的專家，要不要去見見其他基因學者？

scripts.text: Not long ago there was a Geneticist who announced a sensational new life studying research.
scripts.translation: 不久前，有一位基因學者宣佈了一項關於生命研究的轟動性新發現。

scripts.text: You are very knowledgeable. Do you think you might understand her work?
scripts.translation: 你學識淵博，覺得能理解她的研究嗎？

scripts.text: Her study may help you gain the knowledge to help you make a Geneticist!
scripts.translation: 她的研究或許能幫助你獲得知識，從而成為基因學者！

scripts.text: How's that sound? Do you want to meet a Geneticist?
scripts.translation: 聽起來如何？你想見見基因學者嗎？

scripts.text: Of course, I want to meet a Geneticist.
scripts.translation: 當然，我想見見基因學者

scripts.text: I don't want to meet a Geneticist.

scripts.translation: 那位聲名狼藉的基因學者“德弗里斯”。

scripts.text: You can find her in the Alchemy Lab at the western part of Lighthalzen. There is also another Geneticist studying weaponry there, you might want to pay her a visit as well.
scripts.translation: 你可以在裡希塔樂鎮西部的鍊金實驗室找到她。那裡還有一位研究武器的基因學者，你也可以順便去拜訪一下。

scripts.text: Aren't you interested in the study of life?
scripts.translation: 你對生命研究不感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: The infamous Geneticist is studying at the Alchemy Lab in the western part of Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation: 那位惡名在外的基因學者，就在裡希塔樂鎮西部的鍊金實驗室做研究。

scripts.text: If you are interested, go meet with her.
scripts.translation: 有興趣的話，可以去見見她。

scripts.text: Our Alchemist Union brings up many junior alchemists with various promotions and investigations.
scripts.translation: 我們鍊金術士工會通過各種晉升和研究培養了許多年輕鍊金術士。

scripts.text: They have spread to all corners of Midgard and were active in many fields like sciences or special item production methods.
scripts.translation: 他們遍佈米德加爾特，活躍於科學研究、特殊物品製作等各個領域。

scripts.text: We call the members of our new union ^3131FF'Geneticists'^000000.
scripts.translation: 我們將新公會的成員稱為^3131FF“基因學者”^000000。

scripts.text: Geneticists are the ones who have reached their peak potential in the world of Alchemy. They are the ones who currently spearhead alchemy throughout all of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 基因學者在鍊金術領域的造詣已臻巔峰，如今正引領整個米德加爾特的鍊金術發展。

scripts.text: - You still have some unused skill points. -
scripts.translation: - 你還有未使用的技能點。-

scripts.text: Oh! The bloodsucking plant sample C is withering again.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！吸血植物C號樣本又蔫了。

scripts.text: Should I change the ingredient of the growth care?
scripts.translation: 得換換生長護理劑的配方嗎？

scripts.text: Your look tells me that you are doing Alchemy as well right?
scripts.translation: 看你的樣子，應該也在研究鍊金術吧？

scripts.text: People say the number of alchemists is increasing nowadays though there aren't may who study this field properly!
scripts.translation: 人們說現在鍊金術士的數量在增加，但真正深入研究這個領域的人並不多！

scripts.text: They're all too worried about saying things like, ''Look at my bomb damage!'' or ''isn?t my homunculus prettier?''
scripts.translation: 成天只會嚷嚷“看我的炸彈傷害！”“我的生命體是不是更漂亮？”

scripts.text: The Alchemist Union was saying they'd support the researchers but actually what you get from the studying is just 'Spores Which Can Be Easily Raised'!
scripts.translation: 鍊金術士公會說他們會支援研究員，但實際上你從研究中得到的只是“容易培育的魔菇”！

scripts.text: Thanks to that, there are spores everywhere in my lab! There are spores everywhere!
scripts.translation: 多虧了它們，我的實驗室裡到處都是魔菇！到處都是魔菇！

scripts.text: Why do you talk like that?

scripts.translation: 因為我是來自盧恩·米德加茲的！

scripts.text: Have you ever been to Rune-Midgarts? Everyone in Rune-Midgarts speaks like this.
scripts.translation: 你去過盧恩·米德加茲嗎？那裡的人都這樣說話。
我也來自盧恩·米德加茲

scripts.text: Do you come from a Rune-Midgarts village?
scripts.translation: 你來自盧恩·米德加茲的村莊嗎？

scripts.text: My village is very big, everyone there speaks like this.
scripts.translation: 我的村莊很大，那裡的人都這樣說話。

scripts.text: Really! That's why I felt some kind of familiar atmosphere around you.
scripts.translation: 真的！所以我覺得你身上有一種熟悉的氣息。

scripts.text: Meeting a hometown person in Schwarzwald, it's my pleasure to meet you!
scripts.translation: 在秀髮茲發德遇到老鄉，很高興見到你！
嗚哇！那個女人又開始了！

scripts.text: That's the sound of an experiment being carried out by my roommate, Demi Calberine..
scripts.translation: 我室友黛米·卡爾貝林又在做實驗。

scripts.text: Demi's a fire shell technician so she's always noisy like that.
scripts.translation: 她是彈藥技師，天天都這麼吵。

scripts.text: My spores and plants are all freaked out!
scripts.translation: 我的魔菇和植物都被嚇壞了！

scripts.text: I can't do my work with those noisy sounds. It gives me so much stress!!
scripts.translation: 在這種噪音下我無法工作，太有壓力了！！

scripts.text: When I don't feel good, I savor Mr. Orlean's handmade cookies little by little.
scripts.translation: 心情不好的時候，就得慢慢品嚐奧爾良先生手工做的餅乾。

scripts.text: It's a high-quality cookie that I got from Prontera. When I get one bite, it seems like I'm floating to Asgard.
scripts.translation: 那可是從普隆德拉買來的高階餅乾，咬一口，就像飄到了阿斯加德。

scripts.text: The softness of the sweet cookie drowns out the clashing sounds from Demi Calberine.
scripts.translation: 香甜酥軟的滋味，能把黛米·卡爾貝林那些叮噹聲都蓋過去。

scripts.text: Ah, I've eaten all of it.
But it's okay! On the 2nd floor of my room, there are boxes of those!
scripts.translation: 不過沒關係！樓上還囤著好幾箱呢！

scripts.text: I couldn't stop buying it all in bulk. Ho ho ho.
scripts.translation: 一買就忍不住整批買，呵呵呵。

scripts.text: - For now it seems that I -

scripts.translation: - 先讓德弗里斯冷靜下來。 -
- 什麼能讓她冷靜下來呢？-
遞給德弗里斯一塊餅乾
- 咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓 -
- 咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓 -
- 咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓 -

scripts.text: Ah, The sweet buttery taste remains at the end of my tongue.
scripts.translation: 啊，甜美的黃油味道在舌尖縈繞。

scripts.text: This really gives me peace of mind.
scripts.translation: 這真的讓我心情平靜了下來。

scripts.text: Demi is studying hard today as well
scripts.translation: 黛米今天也在努力學習呢。

scripts.text: Huhuhu. She's really a hard worker.
- That cookie changed her mood quick. -
scripts.translation: - 那塊餅乾很快改變了她的心情。-

scripts.text: You came here with a love for Alchemy?
scripts.translation: 你是懷著對鍊金術的熱愛來到這裡的嗎？

scripts.text: Oh wait, We haven't introduced ourselves yet.
scripts.translation: 哦等等，我們還沒自我介紹呢。

scripts.text: I'm very interested in making living things that show new and peculiar growth.
scripts.translation: 我對培育出展現新奇且獨特生長形態的生命體非常感興趣。
你叫什麼名字，年輕的鍊金術士？

scripts.text: That's a very unusual name. Pleased to meet you.
scripts.translation: 真是個不尋常的名字。很高興認識你。

scripts.text: But I can't memorize the name well.
scripts.translation: 但我記不太住這個名字。

scripts.text: So I'll just call you <Popo>. Would that be ok?
scripts.translation: 所以我還是叫你<波波>吧。可以嗎？

scripts.text: Popo, have you heard of my research?
scripts.translation: 波波，你聽說過我的研究嗎？

scripts.text: You came here because of that, am I right?
scripts.translation: 你就是因為那個才來的，對吧？

scripts.text: Well, it's all over your face.
scripts.translation: 嗯，這都寫在你的臉上了。

scripts.text: You don't have to be shy.
Well, as I expected, there really is something that makes homeland people get each other
scripts.translation: 我就知道，老鄉之間就是心有靈犀。

scripts.text: When you saw me in that feverish state, you remembered what I said before and that calmed me down.
scripts.translation: 看我那麼激動，你還記得我之前說的話，知道用餅乾讓我平靜下來。

scripts.text: I like the way you manage yourself and take care to remember small details.
scripts.translation: 你處事穩妥，連小細節都留意到了，我很欣賞。

scripts.text: You have the talent to become a Geneticist.
scripts.translation: 有成為基因學者的天分！

scripts.text: ^FF0000If you become a Geneticist, you can't take the Alchemist's or Biochemist study course that you haven't investigated before.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000轉職為基因學者後，就無法再學習之前尚未研修的鍊金術士、創造者課程。^000000

scripts.text: If that's all right for you, how about giving it a shot right now?.
scripts.translation: 如果沒問題，要不要現在試試？

scripts.text: I want to become a Geneticist!
Even though your knowledge is not that great as that of Geneticists, a fundamental knowledge is also important.
scripts.translation: 雖然你的知識不如基因學者那樣淵博，但基礎知識也很重要。

scripts.text: Popo, come back to me once you've finished your studies.
Are you ready to give it a shot?
You have to do your best! There is no easy way when looking for knowledge!
scripts.translation: 你必須全力以赴！尋找知識沒有捷徑！

scripts.text: What do you think of plants, Popo
scripts.translation: 波波，你覺得植物怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Do you like plants? What kind of plants are you interested in?
scripts.translation: 你喜歡植物嗎？你對哪種植物感興趣？

scripts.text: Ah, please tell me Demi Calberine is not starting again?
scripts.translation: 啊，不會吧，黛米·卡爾貝林又來了？

scripts.text: Please let my expectation be wrong ... Please... Demi, please...
scripts.translation: 千萬別讓我猜中...拜託...黛米，拜託了...

scripts.text: Oh, right. Plants are very important in Alchemy.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了。植物在鍊金術中非常重要。

scripts.text: Alchemy can make Flora's and Geographers grow immensely fast, so they can help in battle, like those Alchemists...
scripts.translation: 鍊金術能讓噬人花、邪惡向日葵迅速生長，幫助戰鬥，就像那些鍊金術士...

scripts.text: Techniques, plants are relatively easy to...
scripts.translation: 技術方面，植物相對容易...

scripts.text: I'll give you the test to become a Geneticist.
scripts.translation: 我會給你一份成為基因學者的測試。

scripts.text: The subject is <The Perfect Soundproof System>!
scripts.translation: 題目是<完美的隔音系統>！

scripts.text: Please think of a way to save me from Demi Calberine's noise, using plants and experimental equipment that are here on the 1st floor of the lab.
scripts.translation: 請利用實驗室一樓的植物和實驗裝置，想出一種方法，讓我免受黛米·卡爾貝林噪音的困擾。

scripts.text: The subject is <The Perfect Soundproof System>!
scripts.translation: 題目是<完美的隔音系統>！

scripts.text: Please think of a way to save me from Demi Calbereine's noise, using plants and experimental equipment that are here on the 1st floor of the lab.
scripts.translation: 請利用實驗室一樓的植物和實驗裝置，想出一種方法，讓我免受黛米·卡爾貝林噪音的困擾。

scripts.text: There are some guides in the cabinet that you may use.
scripts.translation: 櫃子裡有一些指南，你可以參考一下。

scripts.text: Better get started, or I'll start to scream!!!
scripts.translation: 快點開始，不然我就要尖叫了！！！

scripts.text: You can start from the beginning then?
Why are you asking me such things?

scripts.translation: - 叮叮 叮叮 叮叮叮 -
- 叮叮 叮叮 叮叮叮 -

scripts.text: What the hell is Demi Calberine doing?
scripts.translation: 黛米·卡爾貝林到底在幹什麼？

scripts.text: How could you say the study is completed without any result?
scripts.translation: 怎麼沒有任何結果就說研究完成了？

scripts.text: Well, I'll take a look at the seeds Popo made.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我來看看波波種出的種子。

scripts.text: When you put a seed in a Super Cultivator, and adjust the temperature...
scripts.translation: 把種子放進超級培養器，調好溫度...
那真是一種神秘的植物！

scripts.text: The inside of the Cultivator is now full of thorny stems!
scripts.translation: 培養器里長滿了帶刺的莖！

scripts.text: It's as if the stems are making a wall and growing very sturdily and those are getting tangled!
scripts.translation: 粗壯的莖彼此纏繞，簡直像築起了一堵牆！

scripts.text: This plant's properties can be used for many applications!
scripts.translation: 這種植物的特性可以應用於很多領域！

scripts.text: I knew that you were knowledgeable but your ability is more than that!
scripts.translation: 我知道你很博學，但你的能力遠超於此！

scripts.text: I will tell the outcome to the Alchemist Union.
scripts.translation: 我會把成果報給鍊金術士公會，再附上一封推薦信。

scripts.text: I will send a recommendation letter saying that your ability is really great and that you could be a brilliant member.
scripts.translation: 憑你的能力，一定能成為出色的成員。

scripts.text: Getting an answer from the Union will take some time, so could you wait a moment?
scripts.translation: 收到公會的回覆需要一些時間，你能稍等一下嗎？

scripts.text: Why don't you go up to Demi Calberine?
scripts.translation: 為什麼不去找黛米·卡爾貝林呢？

scripts.text: She is a fellow Geneticist, specializing in mini cannons.
scripts.translation: 她也是一位基因學者，專門研究微型火炮。

scripts.text: Go take a look at her experiment results.
scripts.translation: 去看看她的實驗結果吧。

scripts.text: Could you give this message to her? Tell her to conduct her experiments quietly.
scripts.translation: 能把這條訊息轉告給她嗎？告訴她做實驗時安靜一點。

scripts.text: It didn't grow at all, it's withered already.
scripts.translation: 它完全沒長出來，已經枯萎了。

scripts.text: It seems that the mail's has arrived.
You can take a look at the Demi Calberine's work place while we get an answer from the Union.
scripts.translation: 在等待公會回覆期間，你可以去看看黛米·卡爾貝林的工作室。

scripts.text: I've got good news for you!
Oh, it looks like you're not ready to hear it.
scripts.translation: 哦，看來你還沒準備好聽。

scripts.text: First take off that heavy and dirty cart, that doesn't suit you on this happy moment.
scripts.translation: 先把又重又髒的手推車卸下來吧，它可不適合現在這喜慶的時刻。

scripts.text: But you look like you have a lingering desire for previous studies.
scripts.translation: 不過，你似乎還對以前的研究念念不忘。

scripts.text: A letter has arrived from the Alchemist Union.
scripts.translation: 鍊金術士工會寄來了一封信。

scripts.text: I'll read it to you, Popo!
<We are very aware of the brilliant activities you've shown lately.>
scripts.translation: <我們非常清楚你最近展現出的卓越成就。>

scripts.text: This guy is also from my hometown.
<I heard very good news that your research results are taking the step of commercial use.>
scripts.translation: <我聽到一個好訊息，你的研究成果即將投入商業應用。>

scripts.text: <I'm sure it will be a great inspiration for other Alchemists.>
scripts.translation: <我相信這會給其他鍊金術士帶來很大啟發。>

scripts.text: <Come to think of it, you've attached a paper?>
<It was a new plant which makes plants grow super-fast, discovered by an Alchemist named, {0}>
scripts.translation: <一位名叫{0}的鍊金術士，發現了能讓植物飛速生長的新植物。>

scripts.text: <Myself and many other Alchemists from the Alchemist union are taking great interest in this.>
scripts.translation: <我和鍊金術士公會的許多其他鍊金術士都對它很感興趣。>

scripts.text: <We are looking forward to more volumes of study papers and outcomes, especially from other Geneticists who?ve heard this news.>
scripts.translation: <我們期待聽聞此事的其他基因學者，也能提交更多研究論文與成果。>

scripts.text: <I think that {0} has enough ability and talent to be a Geneticist.>
scripts.translation: <我認為{0}具備成為基因學者所需的能力和天賦。>

scripts.text: <Please tell {0} as soon as possible that we are expecting remarkable activities as a Geneticist from now on.>
scripts.translation: <請儘快告訴{0}，從現在開始，我們期待他作為基因學者展現出非凡的成就。>

scripts.text: <The Alchemist Union is very proud of Miss Devries, Miss Demi Calberine and {0} who are excellent talented people.>
scripts.translation: <鍊金術士公會為德弗里斯小姐、黛米·卡爾貝林以及才華橫溢的{0}感到自豪。>

scripts.text: <We hope that you yield good fruits in the future as well.>
scripts.translation: <希望你們未來也能結出豐碩的果實。>

scripts.text: You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
You are a Geneticist from now on!!
scripts.translation: 從現在起你就是基因學者了！！

scripts.text: Just like the word from the Union, I'm also looking forward to your awesome activities.
scripts.translation: 正如公會所說，我也很期待你的精彩表現。

scripts.text: Let's try hard together! To become the best Geneticist!
scripts.translation: 讓我們一起努力吧！成為最棒的基因學者！

scripts.text: Popo, do you want to join my Love Orleans club? It's a club for those that love cookies. Of course, we don't think of doing weird things with Charles Orleans.
scripts.translation: 波波，你想加入我的“奧爾良之愛”俱樂部嗎？這是個喜歡餅乾的人組成的俱樂部。當然，我們可不會和查爾斯·奧爾良做什麼奇怪的事。

scripts.text: Am I that pretty to you? Why are you staring at me like that?
scripts.translation: 我在你眼裡那麼漂亮嗎？為什麼那樣盯著我看？

scripts.text: - There are several cookie bags which are packed carefully in the box. -
scripts.translation: - 箱子裡裝著幾個包裝精美的餅乾袋子。-

scripts.text: - You've taken out a cookie bag out of the box. -
scripts.translation: - 你從箱子裡取出了一個餅乾袋子。-
[寄自：盧恩·米德加茲王國 普隆德拉 查爾斯·奧爾良]
[收件人：秀髮茲發德共和國 裡希塔樂鎮 德弗里斯]

scripts.text: ...Using animals in Alchemy can easily be practiced by anyone.
scripts.translation: ...使用動物進行鍊金術，任何人都能輕鬆上手。

scripts.text: You can put the animals that you want to use on the white tray, imagine the goal you want to make and then practice the alchemy.
scripts.translation: 只需將想使用的動物放在白色托盤上，想像想要製作的目標，然後進行鍊金術即可。

scripts.text: ...The animals that are used in Alchemy might in the danger of getting extinct because of being captured by thoughtless alchemists.
scripts.translation: ...用於鍊金術的動物，可能會因為被無良鍊金術士捕捉而面臨滅絕的危險。
所以我不打算提及它們。

scripts.text: ...The guide of Alchemy using plants is easy to follow, even for a little kid.
scripts.translation: ...使用植物進行鍊金術的指南，連小孩子都能輕鬆看懂。

scripts.text: You can put the plants on the table, and break or cut them, connect them using a simple tool, then do alchemy.
scripts.translation: 只需將植物放在桌上，折斷或切割它們，用簡單的工具連線起來，然後進行鍊金術。
這真是一種非凡的方法。

scripts.text: ...The plants usually used for Alchemy are Bigibigi Grass and Muka Trees that have sharp thorns but are delicate inside and Bogi Creeper whose growth speed is really fast but parasitic on living things.
scripts.translation: ...鍊金術常用植物包括：大比格草、外皮帶有尖刺但內部柔軟的摩卡樹，以及生長極快、會寄生在生物身上的突變長春藤。

scripts.text: ...Using minerals in Alchemy is a way that beginners find pretty easy.
scripts.translation: ...使用礦石進行鍊金術，是初學者覺得相當簡單的方法。

scripts.text: You can put the minerals you want to in the beautifully crafted box, and sing any song that you can think of twice and then practice the alchemy.
scripts.translation: 只需將想使用的礦石放入精美的盒子中，唱兩遍你能想到的任何歌曲，然後進行鍊金術。

scripts.text: ...A mineral that's usually used for Alchemy is 'Phracon' which doesn't cost a lot.
scripts.translation: ...通常用於鍊金術的礦石是價格不貴的“強化武器金屬-級數一”。

scripts.text: ...Alchemy is the easiest thing in the world.
This writer shows a cobalt blue Alchemy demonstration in front of students every week, and always get a big applaud from them.
scripts.translation: 本書作者每週都會為學生演示鈷藍色的鍊金術，總能贏來熱烈掌聲。

scripts.text: I'm sure that you would be into the Alchemy world at the moment you read this book.
scripts.translation: 相信翻開這本書的那一刻，你就會迷上鍊金術的世界。

scripts.text: - This plant doesn't look suitable as an experiment sample. -
scripts.translation: - 這種植物看起來不適合作為實驗樣本。-

scripts.text: Information related to this plant can be found in the Plant Guide in the cabinet.
scripts.translation: 關於這種植物的相關資訊，可以在櫃子裡的植物指南中找到。

scripts.text: - This is a testing table with a lot of equipment. I think I can study the combinations here with plants. -
scripts.translation: - 這是一張配備了許多裝置的實驗桌。我想我可以利用這裡的植物研究各種組合。-

scripts.text: - It's not the time to start an experiment. -
scripts.translation: - 現在不是開始實驗的時候。-

scripts.text: Hmm, I need to gather plant materials first.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我需要先收集植物材料。

scripts.text: What shall I do with these plant materials?
scripts.translation: 這些植物材料該怎麼處理？

scripts.text: Put it into a Testing Flask and Shake.
Inject it into a testing seed.
What kind of seed should I pick?
I've put the prepared materials into the chosen testing seed.
scripts.translation: 已將處理好的材料放入選定的實驗種子中。

scripts.text: Good. Now I can let Miss Devries take a look at this seed!
scripts.translation: 很好。現在可以讓德弗里斯小姐看看這顆種子了！

scripts.text: - It looks like the experiment has failed. I better start over. -
scripts.translation: - 看起來實驗失敗了。還是重新開始吧。-

scripts.text: - It looks like I need to let Miss Devries take a look at this seed! -
scripts.translation: - 看來得讓德弗里斯小姐來看看這顆種子了！-

scripts.text: - This is a testing table with a lot of equipment. I think I can study the combinations here with plants. -
scripts.translation: - 這是一張配備了許多裝置的實驗桌。我想我可以利用這裡的植物研究各種組合。-
嗯~ 那顆螺栓跑到哪裡去了？

scripts.text: Why aren't their enough screws? Didn't I order new ones just recently?
scripts.translation: 螺絲怎麼不夠了？我不是剛訂了一批新的嗎？

scripts.text: When did you... Who are you?
I need to complete and ordered mini cannon today, but I can't find the parts!
scripts.translation: 今天得交一門訂製微型炮，可零件找不到了！

scripts.text: Ugh~ I think they dropped around here somewhere.
scripts.translation: 唉~ 我想它們掉在附近某個地方了。

scripts.text: I only need 10! I need to put the other parts together first... Please could you help me?!
scripts.translation: 我只需要10個！我得先把其他零件組裝起來...你能幫幫我嗎？！

scripts.text: Did you find the parts? No, not yet? You promised, please hurry up!
scripts.translation: 零件找到了嗎？還沒找到？你答應過的，快一點！

scripts.text: With this cart, the firepower won't do well, then let's put it in this way...
scripts.translation: 用這輛手推車的話，火力不夠強，那就這樣裝吧...

scripts.text: Oh, are these my lost screws and bolts?
scripts.translation: 哦，這些是我丟失的螺絲和螺栓嗎？

scripts.text: You asked me to find them!
I don't even know where my mind is.
scripts.translation: 我自己都不知道腦子裡在想什麼。

scripts.text: I will be done quickly with these.
scripts.translation: 我會很快把這些弄好的。
- 咔噠 咔噠 咔噠 -

scripts.text: Okay, I've connected the cannon to the cart... Now shall we test the performance?
scripts.translation: 好了，我把加農炮裝到手推車上了...現在來測試一下效能吧？

scripts.text: Whew. You've been a lot of help to me.
Oh, by the way what made you come here?
scripts.translation: 哦，對了，你為什麼會來這裡呢？

scripts.text: Did you come here to order something
scripts.translation: 是來訂購什麼東西的嗎？
我是基因學者轉職申請者。

scripts.text: I heard that you were very knowledgeable about portable mini cannons and stuff.
scripts.translation: 聽說你很懂行動式迷你加農炮之類的東西。

scripts.text: Yep, I deal with many kinds of cannons.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，各式各樣的火炮我都做。

scripts.text: Nowadays, there are those who want to remodel their carts, so I've been installing several additional functions such as mini cannons to their carts.
scripts.translation: 最近想改良手推車的人很多，我就幫他們加裝微型炮等各種新功能。

scripts.text: Yes, didn't you want to race out when you went downhill?
scripts.translation: 是的，難道你下坡的時候不想衝出去嗎？

scripts.text: Or haven't you ever thought that it was so boring dragging around that plain old cart?
scripts.translation: 或者你從來沒想過拖著那輛普通的手推車很無聊嗎？

scripts.text: Carts are no longer just a wagon for storage.
scripts.translation: 手推車不再只是用來裝東西的貨車。

scripts.text: You could hang a cannon on a cart to make it help you boost your attack power.
scripts.translation: 你可以在手推車上裝一門加農炮，藉此提升攻擊力。

scripts.text: Miss Devries seems to be studying childish experiments downstairs.
scripts.translation: 德弗里斯小姐似乎正在樓下研究一些幼稚的實驗。

scripts.text: I don't understand why those research papers get so popular.
scripts.translation: 我不明白為什麼那些研究論文會那麼受歡迎。

scripts.text: This is the smallest and the lightest cannon in the world.
scripts.translation: 這是世界上最小的、也是最輕的大炮。

scripts.text: This is what I made but isn?t this so cute? Yipee~
scripts.translation: 這是我做的，是不是非常可愛？耶~

scripts.text: Can I get my cart remodeled?
scripts.translation: 我可以改良我的手推車嗎？

scripts.text: Unfortunately, the cart remodeling is only allowed for Geneticists.
scripts.translation: 很遺憾，手推車改良只允許基因學者使用。

scripts.text: It's a rule from the Alchemist Union, so I can't help it.
scripts.translation: 這是鍊金術士公會的規定，我也沒辦法。

scripts.text: You can be a Geneticist too!
scripts.translation: 你也可以成為基因學者！

scripts.text: And what's more, you can?t so the cart remodeling to just any cart.
scripts.translation: 而且，你不能對任何手推車進行改良。

scripts.text: It can only be done on quality certified carts that've been polished for a long time.
scripts.translation: 只能對經過長時間打磨、獲得質量認證的手推車進行改良。

scripts.text: You should practice your cart skills whenever you have time until you become a Geneticist.
scripts.translation: 轉職基因學者之前，有空就練練手推車技能吧。

scripts.text: Till your muscles are dealing with your cart in powerful harmony and your cart moves beautifully,
scripts.translation: 要練到身體與車子配合默契，揮動起來得心應手...

scripts.text: If you want, ^FF0000I'll show you a good training spot.^000000
scripts.translation: 願意的話，^FF0000我帶你去個練習的好地方。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Devries won't like it much^000000, but it's the best place. Haha.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000德弗里斯可不會高興^000000，不過那裡最合適，哈哈。

scripts.text: How about you swing your cart around as practice?
When you swing your cart at least ^FF0000100^000000 times, you can get rid of stress and the cart will be polished up enough.
scripts.translation: 至少揮^FF0000100^000000次，既能減壓，也能把車子練順手。

scripts.text: Well, I need to get to work for the next order.
scripts.translation: 好了，我需要去處理下一個訂單了。

scripts.text: Come and find me whenever you need training.
scripts.translation: 需要訓練時，隨時來找我。

scripts.text: I'll help you out whenever you need your cart remodeled.
scripts.translation: 需要改良手推車時，我也會幫你。

scripts.text: - What's this? I feel like the floor is missing somewhere. -
scripts.translation: - 這是什麼？感覺地板好像缺了一塊。-

scripts.text: It seem Miss Devries found out that I put you in her spore pen.
scripts.translation: 看來德弗里斯小姐發現我把你關進她的孢子飼養場了。

scripts.text: It's funny when you look at her face. After you've killed all those spores.
scripts.translation: 等你殺光那些孢子後，看看她的表情一定很有趣。

scripts.text: Do you want to enter the spore pen?
scripts.translation: 你想進入孢子飼養場嗎？

scripts.text: Have fun swinging your cart around~
scripts.translation: 盡情揮舞你的手推車吧~

scripts.text: What a shame! I wanted to see Miss Devries's angry face.
scripts.translation: 真可惜！我本來還想看看德弗里斯小姐生氣的樣子呢。

scripts.text: It seem Miss Devries found out that I put you in her spore pen.
scripts.translation: 看來德弗里斯小姐發現我把你關進她的孢子飼養場了。

scripts.text: It's funny when you look at her face. After you've killed all those spores.
scripts.translation: 等你殺光那些孢子後，看看她的表情一定很有趣。

scripts.text: - There are so many scattered things on the floor that the lab is in chaos. -
scripts.translation: - 地上散落著許多東西，實驗室一片狼藉。-

scripts.text: - You found a little metal fragment. -
scripts.translation: - 你發現了一塊金屬破片。-

scripts.text: - I think I've gathered all of the parts. -
scripts.translation: - 我想我已經收集齊所有的零件了。-

scripts.text: If you bully my spores, I'll scream!!!
scripts.translation: 如果你欺負我的魔菇，我會尖叫的！！！

scripts.text: - I'd better get out before I get caught by Miss Devries. -
scripts.translation: - 我最好在被德弗里斯小姐抓到之前離開這裡。-

scripts.text: - 'Monthly Bang!' magazines are piled up in disorder. -
scripts.translation: - 《砰！月刊》雜誌雜亂地堆在一起。-

scripts.text: - A checker patterned blanket set which looks like it was picked carefully is too good for this dirty bed. -
scripts.translation: - 這套看起來精心挑選的格紋毯子，放在這張髒床上簡直太可惜了。-

scripts.text: < Do you want to have my pretty room? Do you have enough zeny? Is there enough room? Run to the Lighthalzen Department Store right away and get the most high-end wall papers and interior accessories! >
scripts.translation: < 想要擁有我這樣漂亮的房間嗎？你有足夠的Zeny嗎？有足夠的空間嗎？快去裡希塔樂鎮百貨商店，選購最高階的桌布和室內裝飾品！ >

scripts.text: < Luxurious candles that'll lighten up your room, a huge golden mirror that every lady owns, you cannot miss any of them! >
scripts.translation: < 能照亮房間的奢華蠟燭，每位女士都擁有的巨大金邊鏡子，你絕對不能錯過它們！ >

scripts.text: - It's a room that looks like a storehouse, thanks to so many parcels piled up in the room. -
scripts.translation: - 房間裡堆滿了包裹，看起來像個倉庫。-
